title: Sunrise Hotel and Resort
paragraphs: Sunrise Hotel and Resort offers comfortable accommodation for business and leisure travelers. Every room and suite includes a work desk and a private lounge chair by the window.
Our concierge desk is open around the clock for local tour and restaurant booking. Housekeeping visits every room twice a day to keep it clean and fresh.
Guests can dine at our hotel restaurant, which offers a wide menu of local and international cuisine. After dinner, relax at the resort pool or the quiet reading lounge on the top floor.
Book directly on our website this month and receive a free breakfast amenity for every reservation. Rooms fill quickly in the holiday season, so early booking is recommended.
